elena (docs): Quick flag — the /jobs endpoint doc has a few mismatches that surfaced in a customer integration test. Root issues: 1) example request still shows `priority: "high"` (string), runtime expects an enum `priority` with values [low, medium, high] but as a token (not quoted in examples), 2) response example shows `status: 202` (number) instead of `status: "queued"` (string enum), and 3) error examples show `error: { message: "..." }` but runtime returns `errors: [{ code, message }]`. Opening a PR to align examples and add a migration note.

marco (eng-api): Thanks — confirmed. Runtime change: priority is an enum, but our OpenAPI had it as string with quotes which confuses some docs generators. Please show example without misleading inline JSON strings for enums, e.g. "priority": "high" is fine for JSON but clarify the allowed enum values in the param table. For responses: runtime returns `status` as string (`queued`, `running`, `completed`, `failed`). The numeric HTTP status code was accidentally copied into the body example; fix that. Error shape: we standardized on `errors` array a while ago; old `error` object is legacy. Behavior note: error HTTP 400/422 responses contain `errors: [{ code: "invalid_param", message: "...", field: "..." }]`.

tess (sdk): Our SDK surface currently maps the server `errors` array to an exception type that exposes `errorCodes()` and `firstError()`. Docs should show how to handle both the new array and the legacy single-object shape for robustness. I'll open a small SDK patch that accepts either `error` or `errors` and normalizes, but docs should show the canonical handling pattern. Suggest snippet for Node: ```js
try {
  await client.jobs.create(payload)
} catch (err) {
  const details = err.errors || [err.error];
  console.error('job failed', details.map(e => e.message).join('; '));
}
```

ben (docs-review): A couple of nits for the PR: 1) please add explicit Content-Type in all curl examples (`-H "Content-Type: application/json"`), 2) use canonical `Authorization` header casing, 3) include JSON language fences for machine parsing. Also add a small migration callout titled "Jobs API: example and error-shape corrections" showing old->new snippets.

elena (docs): Will do. I'll update the OpenAPI examples, request/response example blocks, and add the migration callout with an explicit note: "If you previously parsed `error` (object), switch to `errors` (array) and handle multiple error entries; SDKs will normalize for you in the next release." Draft migration snippet that I'll include: ```bash
# old
curl -X POST $URL -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"priority": "high", "task": "index"}'
# new (canonical)
curl -X POST $URL -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"priority": "high", "task": "index"}'
``` (note: same payload shape but doc clarifies allowed enum and response shapes).

marco (eng-api): Also add runtime behavior note: if both `error` and `errors` are present (some bridge services), `errors` array is authoritative. For `status`, if the job is accepted but not processed, body `status` is `queued` and HTTP status is 202. Add that explicitly to avoid confusion where folks expect numeric status in body.

tess (sdk): I'll prepare the SDK PR to normalize errors and add example in our README showing catching and reading `err.errors`. Will link the PR from the docs once it's ready. ETA tomorrow morning.

ops-bot: docs-ci: running linter and example validations... (warning: one example used single quotes inside JSON block)

elena (docs): Fixed quoting nit, pushed PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4215 — updates include: request/response examples fixed, error example normalized to `errors` array, migration note, and code snippets for handling errors in JS/py.

ben (docs-review): Quick pass done — looks good. One suggestion: add a tiny QA test for the docs change: POST with invalid param and assert `errors[0].code == "invalid_param"` and `status == "queued"` behavior for 202. Add that to the PR description so QE can pick it up.

elena (docs): Merging after CI. Thanks everyone for fast turnaround — will follow up to add Tess's SDK PR link once merged. :tada:
